simsdotnet.title: 1. Start / templates
simsdotnet.description:
Scheduled window: Oct 21 – Nov 13
Client responsibility: Provide masters, paper records, partial POs / SOs, stock counts
Project team responsibility: Mapping, validation rules, unique legacy document IDs
Source: SIMS.xlsx · Migration Playbook · A4:D4.

simsdotnet.title: 2. Change controls
simsdotnet.description:
Scheduled window: Nov 16–17 setup; then client BAU
Client responsibility: Track new, changed, cancelled and partially fulfilled transactions until freeze
Project team responsibility: Explain controlled log; do not assume automated deltas from Excel/paper
Source: SIMS.xlsx · Migration Playbook · A5:D5.

simsdotnet.title: 3. Clean / initial load
simsdotnet.description:
Scheduled window: Nov 2 – Dec 17
Client responsibility: Resolve duplicate entries, missing quantities, locations and paper-only records
Project team responsibility: Stage loading, exception report, first rehearsal and quantity checks
Source: SIMS.xlsx · Migration Playbook · A6:D6.

simsdotnet.title: 4. Protected break
simsdotnet.description:
Scheduled window: Dec 18 – Jan 5
Client responsibility: Continue normal business recordkeeping (not project work)
Project team responsibility: No project activity, UAT, deployment, or planned data reconciliation
Source: SIMS.xlsx · Migration Playbook · A7:D7.

simsdotnet.title: 5. Reconcile after break
simsdotnet.description:
Scheduled window: Jan 6 – 11
Client responsibility: Supply all changes from break; validate open POs/SOs and stock
Project team responsibility: Apply baseline + changes, reconcile no double-counting
Source: SIMS.xlsx · Migration Playbook · A8:D8.

simsdotnet.title: 6. Full dress rehearsal
simsdotnet.description:
Scheduled window: Jan 11 – 12
Client responsibility: Validate sample open orders, receipts, inventory and delivery balances
Project team responsibility: Run idempotent import, verify backups and rollback
Source: SIMS.xlsx · Migration Playbook · A9:D9.

simsdotnet.title: 7. Accept data and release
simsdotnet.description:
Scheduled window: Jan 13 – 14
Client responsibility: Sign control totals, freeze plan, final go/no-go
Project team responsibility: Verify discrepancy closure, access, monitoring and rollback
Source: SIMS.xlsx · Migration Playbook · A10:D10.

simsdotnet.title: 8. Freeze / production load
simsdotnet.description:
Scheduled window: Jan 15 – 17
Client responsibility: Freeze data, approve final snapshot and signed balances
Project team responsibility: Re-import clean snapshot, verify open obligations and stock
Source: SIMS.xlsx · Migration Playbook · A11:D11.

simsdotnet.title: 9. Single cutover
simsdotnet.description:
Scheduled window: Jan 18
Client responsibility: Begin transactions in ERP only
Project team responsibility: Live support and balancing
Source: SIMS.xlsx · Migration Playbook · A12:D12.

simsdotnet.title: 10. Hypercare
simsdotnet.description:
Scheduled window: Jan 18 – 29
Client responsibility: Report exceptions; validate opening activity
Project team responsibility: Daily operational reconciliation + fixes
Source: SIMS.xlsx · Migration Playbook · A13:D13.
